title: 第90章 自作孽不可活

第90章 自作孽不可活-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

老爷子最近迷上易经八卦了，逮着机会就向赵安坤讨教，从五行相生相克，到风水布局讲究，问得不亦乐乎，赵安坤也耐心一一解答。

等回到了老爷子住的家属院，赵安坤忍不住感慨道：“吴叔，您这悟性可比吴姜这小子强多了！我说一遍您就懂，他倒好，教十遍都记不住，纯属榆木脑袋。”

吴姜瞪了赵安坤一眼，赵安坤却是哈哈笑着没有理他。

老爷子快和赵安坤成了忘年交了，死活拉着他不让去宾馆，让吴姜炒了几个小菜，爷仨开始喝了起来。

吃饭的时候，吴姜一句话都插不进去，听着两人左青龙、右白虎，又说什么“龙要真、砂要秀，水要弯、穴要藏”，吴姜听得眼珠子都直了，满脑子都是问号。

直到老爷子喝得脸颊泛红，都有些晃荡了，这顿晚饭才算结束。

吴姜松了口气，伺候老爷子回房睡觉后，出来和赵安坤相视一笑，心照不宣地起身，各自回房。

很快，两个鬼差在客厅集合了，只是，当赵安坤看清吴姜腰间悬挂的令牌时，一句“卧槽”脱口而出，眼睛瞪得溜圆，满脸的不敢置信。

“你......你小子什么时候成一等鬼差了？”

上次两人合作对付恶鬼的时候，明明都是二等鬼差，这才过了多久，这臭小子就晋升了？

吴姜此刻觉得自己浑身那是一个通透，爽啊，让你丫的先前嘲笑我！

吴姜呵呵一笑，得意的说道：“没办法，都是运气，最近碰到的厉鬼比较多，侥幸攒了一些功劳，不知不觉就晋升了。”

这下赵安坤更加破防了，老子怎么就没这样的侥幸，平时除了地府派发的抓捕怨灵的任务，一辈子都没碰上几个厉鬼。

吴姜也不知道该怎么解释，貌似自己见鬼的几率确实多了点，但那都是偶然啊，他也没办法控制。

“好了好了，赵叔，别羡慕了，赶紧出发，以免夜长梦多，那老鬼要是趁机跑了，咱们可就白忙活了。”

Chapter 90: Self-inflicted evil will lead to death - "The City God is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

The old man has recently become obsessed with the Bagua of the Book of Changes. He took the opportunity to ask Zhao Ankun for advice, from the mutual support and restraint of the five elements to the importance of Feng Shui layout. He was very interested in asking questions, and Zhao Ankun also patiently answered them one by one.

When he returned to the family home where the old man lived, Zhao Ankun couldn't help but sigh: "Uncle Wu, your understanding is much better than that kid Wu Jiang! You can understand it once I tell you it, but he is not good at it. He can't remember it after being taught it ten times. He is just stupid."

Wu Jiang glared at Zhao Ankun, but Zhao Ankun laughed and ignored him.

The old man had almost become friends with Zhao Ankun. He dragged him to the hotel and asked Wu Jiang to cook some side dishes, and the three of them started to drink.

While eating, Wu Jiang couldn't get in a word. Listening to the two men, Qinglong on the left and White Tiger on the right, saying, "The dragon must be real, the sand must be beautiful, the water must be curved, and the holes must be hidden." Wu Jiang's eyes were straightened when he heard that, and his mind was filled with questions.

The dinner was not over until the old man's cheeks were red from drinking and he was a little swaying.

Wu Jiang breathed a sigh of relief, and after helping the old man go back to his room to sleep, he came out and smiled at each other, got up tacitly, and went back to their rooms.

Soon, the two ghost agents gathered in the living room. However, when Zhao Ankun saw the token hanging on Wu Jiang's waist, he blurted out "fuck", his eyes widened, and his face was full of disbelief.

"You...when did you become a first-class ghost?"

The last time the two of them worked together to deal with evil spirits, they were both second-class ghost officers. How long had it passed before this brat was promoted?

At this moment, Wu Jiang felt that his whole body was so transparent. It felt so good that you laughed at me earlier!

Wu Jiang chuckled and said proudly: "I can't help it, it's all luck. I've encountered a lot of evil ghosts recently. I was lucky enough to earn some merit, and I got promoted without knowing it."

Now Zhao Ankun was even more vulnerable. How come I am not so lucky? Except for the missions assigned by the underworld to capture the ghosts, I have never encountered many evil ghosts in my life.

Wu Jiang didn't know how to explain it. It seemed that he had a higher chance of seeing ghosts, but that was all accidental and he couldn't control it.

"Okay, okay, Uncle Zhao, don't be envious and set off quickly to avoid long nights and dreams. If the old ghost takes the opportunity to run away, our work will be in vain."
